## The change

- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (~L1440 on `main` `05cc3ee`), the `record:details` section key `hideEmpty`. Today its `describe()` says: "Set `false` to render empty rows, keeping the section's label skeleton on an all-empty record". The new text keeps the default as it is: the key is on, and an all-empty section renders nothing. For `false` it says that **in read-only mode** an all-empty section renders its heading and one fold row ("N empty fields · Show", the same fold mixed sections use). Edit mode renders every row, editable.
